card.name: Alkylating agent labels: dose and class
card.fires_on: Positions inside text on alkylating chemotherapy drugs (chlorambucil, lomustine, dacarbazine). It fires on 'other' or 'alk-yl' in 'other alkylating agents', and on the space just before a dose number.

modes.label: Alkylating agents phrase
modes.description: The word 'other' or the 'yl' in 'alkylating' when naming the drug class after a specific drug.
modes.example: There may be cross-hypersensitivity (skin rash) between chlorambucil and<< other>> alkylating agents.

modes.label: Before a dose number
modes.description: The blank position right before a mg/kg or mg per square meter dose figure in chemotherapy dosing text.
modes.example: The recommended dosage of Dacarbazine for Injection, USP in the treatment of Hodgkin’s disease is<< >>150 mg/square meter body
